## Summary

Describe the focused change and the user-facing or maintainer-facing impact.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Include focused tests, SpecTrace checks, package checks, ProtocolLab smoke checks, manual validation, or skipped checks with reasons.

```text
command:
result:
```

## Reviewer Notes

Call out anything reviewers should pay attention to:

- Public API, wire-protocol, package, security, compatibility, or manual validation impact.
- ProtocolLab package, run-plan, fixture, or evidence impact.
- Local or manual checks that CI cannot prove.
- Known limitations, follow-up work, or intentionally skipped checks.

## Boundary Check

- [ ] I have not included credentials, private transcripts, private repository paths, local Codex auth state, private ProtocolLab artifacts, or unpublished operator data.
- [ ] I updated documentation, samples, requirements, verification records, package metadata, or public API baselines when the public surface changed.
- [ ] I listed validation evidence or explained why validation was not applicable.
- [ ] I called out public API, protocol, package, security, compatibility, and ProtocolLab impact where relevant.

## Contributor Agreement

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTOR-AGREEMENT.md`](../CONTRIBUTOR-AGREEMENT.md).
- [ ] I will follow [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] If required, I will sign by commenting exactly: `I have read the Incursa Contributor Agreement and I hereby assign my contribution rights as described.`
